payload.title: Site labels for other modules have no module-neutral contract: sensor, HR, dashboard, console and tenant-admin surfaces read farm-service registry queries (sites, activeSites, activeSiteAccessCatalog) directly and receive farm attributes where they need only labels
evidence: web/modules/sensor-module/src/hooks/useLocationHierarchy.ts:52-60 (sensor reads farm sites with type and status)
apps/farm-service/src/common/authz/permission-matrix.ts:473 (sites is open to every role, which these callers rely on)
payload.rule_violated: D2 and the open decision 3 default: other modules read farm site labels only, through a module-neutral contract, never through farm-private registry reads.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-08, release R4.
